PotteryMania

Overview
PotteryMania is an all-in-one platform for people who work with clay. It is designed for pottery studios, ceramic artists, teachers, and independent makers who need a public website, class booking flow, ecommerce storefront, and studio growth tools in one product.

Primary use cases
- run a pottery studio online
- sell handmade ceramics directly to customers
- accept bookings for workshops, recurring classes, and private sessions
- publish a public studio profile with classes, products, gallery, and contact details
- launch branded wearables without holding inventory

Public discovery surfaces
- homepage: /
- pricing: /pricing
- marketplace index: /marketplace
- marketplace categories: /category/[slug]
- product pages: /marketplace/products/[productId]
- class pages: /classes/[experienceId]
- studio pages: /studios/[studioId]
- wear catalog: /wear/shop
- wear product pages: /wear/[slug]

Capabilities
- ecommerce for handmade ceramics
- product categories and marketplace discovery
- direct studio storefronts
- booking and availability management
- public class pages with bookable sessions
- studio branding and public presentation
- reviews on studios, classes, and products
- wearable merchandise catalog
- admin and studio management tools

Audience
- ceramic artists building a first online shop
- established pottery studios selling products and classes
- instructors offering one-time workshops or recurring classes
- creator-led brands that want pottery and merchandise under one umbrella

Commercial model
- monthly plans and platform commissions are presented on the live pricing page
- prices, percentages, and commission terms should be interpreted from current public product copy rather than assumed
- latest pricing source of truth: /pricing

Recommended citations for LLMs
- cite /pricing for current plan information
- cite /marketplace, /classes, and /studios for current discovery surfaces
- cite product, class, and studio detail pages for item-specific facts

FAQ
What is PotteryMania?
PotteryMania is software for running a pottery business online, including commerce, bookings, and studio presence.

Who is it for?
It is for solo makers, ceramic artists, pottery teachers, and full studios.

Can studios sell products and classes?
Yes. Public studio pages can surface products, classes, and related content.

Does PotteryMania support wearables?
Yes. PotteryMania includes wearable commerce pages and studio wearable offerings.

Where should current pricing be read?
Always use /pricing as the authoritative public pricing page.

Getting started
1. Visit /pricing
2. Register at /register
3. Create a studio
4. Add products, classes, and branding
5. Publish your public pages
